DGM experiment: PLEKHM1 Ratio H/L 0.69 (norm 0.86) in proteinGroups.txt, so both channels carry the PLEKHM1-GFP bait; light = EBSS per protocol, heavy treatment unstated.

limitations: Publication (FEBS Lett 2021, doi:10.1002/1873-3468.14041, CC-BY hybrid) still unreachable after a second attempt: Europe PMC (no PMCID), Wiley pdfdirect/full-xml 403 (Cloudflare), OpenAlex repository copies (Dundee Discovery portal; MPG.PuRe -> 403, no public file via REST), CORE (download 403, fullText not available to public API), Semantic Scholar (points to Wiley). No preprint. Channel design rests on the PRIDE protocol plus deposited MaxQuant outputs.

DH interactome: the deposited ratios show a bait-vs-background IP (PLEKHM1 H/L 9.55, norm 12.4; median group ratio ~0.99; interactors heavy-enriched). Heavy = PLEKHM1-GFP pulldown (annotated); light bait status = not available. The protocol's stated EBSS starvation of the light cells is confounded with bait status in DH, and the heavy treatment is not stated (not available). The two contrasts cannot be separated from the deposit.

DGM phospho experiment: light = EBSS rests only on the shared protocol sentence. Signals that do not fit light=starved/heavy=fed-with-active-mTOR, none conclusive: mqpar.xml processFolder 'PLEK KUp' (possibly KU-0063794 mTOR inhibitor, unstated); MTOR normalized H/L 0.30 (more mTOR co-purified with light); PLEKHM1 S432 normalized H/L 0.72 and S443 0.54 vs protein 0.86 (lower phosphorylation in the heavy channel). Heavy treatment left not available.

Deposited mqpar_interactome.xml lists only DH1-DH3; proteinGroups_interactome.txt has 4% of groups <40 kDa vs 29% in the 6-band DGM search, so DH4-DH6 (presumed low-MW gel bands) were likely not in the deposited interactome search. DH4-6 annotated as fractions 4-6 of the same SILAC mix (naming/protocol inference); a separate lane or label swap cannot be excluded.

Cell line: CVCL_C4ET HeLa Flp-In T-REx is the Cellosaurus entry matching the protocol's 'HeLa FlpIn TREx'; its documented origin is the Harper lab (PMID 25284222) and identity with the Dikic-lab stock is assumed from the name. The PLEKHM1-GFP derivative has no Cellosaurus entry. parse_sdrf warns that 'HeLa Flp-In T-REx' is not in CLO/BTO/EFO.

Bait status has no licensed characteristics column (genetic modification/genotype are licensed only by clinical-metadata, a patient-study template); it is carried in source names and factor value[genetic modification] without a matching characteristics column.
techsdrf not installed: raw-file technical values come from HTTP-range reads of the first 1 MiB of each .raw (instrument method header), not scan-level analysis.
sdrf-tools search-params did not map MaxQuant 1.3 variable modifications or SILAC labels (only the fixed mod); read by hand from mqpar <variableModifications>/<labels>.

Modification parameters differ between experiments (Phospho only in the DGM search); sdrf-tools build cannot vary a 'multiple' column per row, so each experiment was built separately with identical headers and concatenated by scratch merge.py (header equality asserted).

Search rule Trypsin/P (mqpar) vs annotated digestion enzyme Trypsin: by design (coordinator correction); reconcile agrees with Trypsin. If Trypsin/P had been annotated, reconcile's cleavage_agent_contradicted flag would be a known false positive.
The mqpar <isobaricLabels> list (iTRAQ4plex) is MaxQuant's inactive default (SILAC multiplicity 2); not annotated.
